_about: Owner group names on the sales site. 'aliases' turns a buyer name from the CEC Log into the owner group name the SNF dashboard uses (Facility extras sheet, owner_group), so both sites match. 'fill' gives a buyer group for sales whose CEC Log row has none, by CEC id. 'cms_chain' names a group's chain in CMS's national chain file when CMS can't be matched through the group's Rhode Island homes. Edit here and rebuild.
